capabilities: Add sources by ISBN, DOI, arXiv ID or URL
Import PDF, EPUB, ebook and document files beside their notes
Cite while writing and export CSL-JSON, BibLaTeX or BibTeX
Migrate a Zotero library with preview and undo
disambiguation: Not a flashcard or card-stack tool; it manages a library of research sources and their files.
extras: Early release tested only on the author's vault; README advises keeping a backup. Full guides live on the project website, and the library stays usable as plain Markdown and folders if the plugin is removed.
intentEvidence: Move from Zotero with a preview and undo
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to collect references, read attached PDFs and ebooks, and produce citations while writing.
